top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Wyścig Niepołomice's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
Wyścig Niepołomice's Forest gravel tracks, Fast hardpack forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 61 miles.
When someone attacks on fast, nearly flat forest gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Wyścig Niepołomice's fast, nearly flat forest gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Wyścig Niepołomice, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
61 miles on fast, nearly flat forest gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
2-minute all-out efforts on fast, nearly flat forest gravel. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Wyścig Niepołomice. Train it until it feels boring.
At Wyścig Niepołomice, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Wyścig Niepołomice's fast, nearly flat forest gravel actually does to you.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Smooth pedaling at 61 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Wyścig Niepołomice’s 61 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Wyścig Niepołomice requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on fast, nearly flat forest gravel to build confidence. Expect: forest gravel tracks, fast hardpack, short technical sectors.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Gravel Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 61 miles of fast, nearly flat forest gravel in Niepołomice, Małopolska, Poland.
